claim: Mons Belfry is open Tue-Sun 10am-6pm (last admission 5.15pm), closed Mondays, with exceptional closures on 29 and 31 May 2026 for Doudou; tickets €7-€10 adults, free 1st Sunday and with Mons Card.
quote: Opening times: Tuesday to Sunday, 10am to 6pm. Last admission 5.15pm. The Belfry of Mons, recognized by UNESCO since 1999, is an iconic landmark... As the only baroque belfry in Belgium

claim: The Mons Belfry is part of the UNESCO World Heritage 'Belfries of Belgium and France' inscription (ref. 943), originally listed in 1999 as 32 Belgian belfries and extended in 2005 to include 23 French belfries plus Gembloux.

The Ducasse de Mons (Doudou) takes place annually on Trinity Sunday (57 days after Easter); in 2026 this falls on Sunday 31 May, with the Car d'Or descent on Saturday 30 May; UNESCO-inscribed in 2008 under 'Processional giants and dragons in Belgium and France'.
quote: The Ducasse de Mons occurs annually on Trinity Sunday, which falls 57 days after Easter... Trinity Sunday 2026 will be May 31st... recognised as one of the Masterpieces of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO

claim: Maison Van Gogh in Cuesmes (where Vincent lived Dec 1878-Oct 1880 during his Borinage period) is open Tue-Sun 10am-4pm (last admission 3.15pm); admission €2-4, free under 12 and on 1st Sunday.
quote: Tuesday to Sunday, 10am to 4pm (last admission at 3.15pm)... Admission fees range from 2 to 4 euros... Rue du Pavillon, 3 — 7033 Cuesmes

claim: The Mundaneum (the Belgian 'paper Google' archive-museum) is open Wed-Fri 10am-5pm and Sat-Sun 10am-6pm, closed Monday and Tuesday; exhibition entry €2-9, free 1st Sunday.
quote: Wednesday to Sunday... Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday from 10am to 5pm, and Saturday and Sunday from 10am to 6pm. The Mundaneum is closed on Monday and Tuesday

claim: Mons Memorial Museum (in the restored 1871 Machine à Eau, military history of Mons through WWI and WWII) opens Tue-Sun 10am-6pm (last admission 4.30pm), closed Mondays; €7 adults, €3 children 3-18.
quote: closed on Mondays and open Tuesday through Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00... Adults, students, and seniors 60+: €7; Children (3-18): €3

claim: Collégiale Sainte-Waudru is a free-entry Brabantine Gothic collegiate church open Mon-Sat 9am-6pm and Sun 9.30am-6pm; the Treasury (€5 adults, €4 reduced) opens Tue-Sun 12pm-6pm and is closed Monday.
quote: Church: Monday to Saturday 9:00-18:00; Sunday 9:30-18:00. Treasury: Open Tuesday to Sunday from 12pm to 6 pm... adults €5, students and those 60+ €4

claim: Musée du Doudou (Grand-Place, in a 1625 red-brick building converted by Sofateliers for Mons 2015) tells the story of the Ducasse year-round; open Tue-Sun 10am-6pm (last entry 5.15pm), €9 / €6 reduced, closed Mondays.
quote: Tuesday to Sunday from 10am to 6pm, with the last visitor able to enter at 5:15 pm... €9 for regular admission and €6 for reduced rates... Grand'Place

claim: Les Anciens Abattoirs, a 19th-century former slaughterhouse complex on Rue de la Trouille hosting contemporary visual arts and crafts shows (including BeCraft gallery), opens Tue-Sun 12pm-6pm only during exhibition periods, closed Mondays.
quote: Tuesday to Sunday from 12:00 to 18:00 during exhibition periods... Rue de la Trouille, 17 - 7000 Mons

claim: Mons 2015 European Capital of Culture left a substantial built legacy including Daniel Libeskind's MICX International Congress Centre (golden anodised-aluminium and Robinia-wood prow) and a Santiago Calatrava station then under construction.
quote: Congress centre by Daniel Libeskind opens in Europe's 2015 Capital of Culture... two volumes that appear to have collided

claim: Mons 2015 created five new museums plus a concert hall, restored Van Gogh site and 15+ urban installations — including the Mons Memorial Museum (€7m, in the Machine à Eau), the Musée du Doudou (€4m) and a full Belfry restoration with new exhibition spaces (€7m).
quote: Mons created five new museums, a concert hall, a restored van Gogh site and more than 15 urban installations

claim: BAM (Beaux-Arts Mons), reopened in 2024 as part of the new CAP cluster (Culture, Art et Patrimoine), runs temporary exhibitions Tue-Sun 10am-6pm and is closed outside exhibition periods and on Mondays.
quote: Tuesday to Sunday from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. (the Museum of Fine Arts is closed outside of temporary exhibitions)

claim: Baudour to central Mons is roughly 10-13 km by car, around 17-20 minutes' drive, making Mons an easy half-day outing from d'Eugénie à Emilie.
quote: The driving distance between Mons and Baudour is 10.8 km, with an estimated drive time of 17 minutes
